fml.menu.mods.info.description.infinite_:
An endless forest stretches before you, accompanied by the greatest trees, and in the farthest distance, fireflies light your way.

But the footsteps behind you fall silent the moment you stop. The fireflies go out one by one — along with any hope of return. The forest does not wait. It watches in silence. And it erases the screams.
tooltip.infinite_forest.ice_crystal: Brings a sense of unease, cold and loneliness
page.infinite_forest.awake_description:
It is day, and...
Once again I try to escape the strange dream that has been troubling me for a long time.
In it, I wandered through a mysterious forest.
The tallest trees, whose crowns deepened and crowded deep in the sky, give me no peace.
The quiet whisper of leaves, the cool earth on which leaves and flowers were strikingly scattered,
throw me into a shiver.
It is time to deal with my problems. From this day I begin to keep a diary...
message.infinite_forest.typing: Seems empty here. I think it's time to fix that...

ancient_note.infinite_forest.flames_desc: I love fireflies. They glow so beautifully, and it seems they are not afraid of the dark. I love them, and it seems they love me.
ancient_note.infinite_forest.unity_with_: I like our places. It's warmer here than in the rest of the forest. I love sitting by the lake shore, and I love when fireflies fly over it. Very beautiful. And even though it's always dark here, there is something extraordinary about this place, not like in our village. Here I feel calm, only a rare wind sways the grass, filling it with presence...
ancient_note.infinite_forest.moon_flower: Today I am so tired, again writing unnecessary work, and also found a strange place. Slippery, as if frozen. And in the very center there is a strange blue flower. Any surface that touches it instantly freezes. I checked. Let it be... moonflower. I hope luck smiles on me to pick it.
